item_name: Smith & Wesson Medium SWAT Assisted Opening Knife
item_short_desc: The Smith & Wesson Medium SWAT Assisted Opening Knife has 3 1/4" 4034 Stainless Steel Combo Edge blade.  It has a black aluminum handle with inserts and a spear point to go along with the serrated blade.  The Smith & Wesson Medium SWAT Assisted Opening Knife also comes with a pocket clip for easy transport.
